source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Entry 2075 documents updateSyncState after processed items and resolves the initial-sync test on it. Historical Rust processes Create/Update/Delete for one response, calls UpdateSyncState, then checks includes_last_folder_in_range and can request another page. The callback therefore completes that batch, not necessarily the whole hierarchy operation. The skipped second-page task did not exercise this limit. Fixed Exchange IDL explicitly distinguishes onSyncStateTokenChanged from onSuccess, and current folder-sync test listeners resolve on onSuccess. Use the final completion callback when callers need all pages. No live server or runtime test ran.
title: An Exchange sync token callback can precede complete hierarchy sync
